definitions.explanation: The emission of light by a substance that has absorbed light or radiation. In everyday use, most commonly refers to fluorescent lighting or fluorescent colors.

examples.japanese: {蛍光|けいこう}{灯|とう}を{交換|こうかん}する。
{蛍光|けいこう}ペンで{大事|だいじ}なところに{線|せん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: To highlight important parts with a highlighter pen.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}の{安全|あんぜん}のために、{蛍光|けいこう}{色|いろ}のベストを{着|き}て{走|はし}ることにしている。
examples.english: For safety at night, I make it a point to wear a fluorescent-colored vest when running.

notes:
Refers to fluorescence — the property of emitting bright light. Composed of {蛍|けい} (firefly) + {光|こう} (light), literally "firefly light," because the glow resembles that of a firefly. Most commonly encountered in compounds related to fluorescent lighting and colors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛍光|けいこう}{灯|とう}: fluorescent light tube
- {蛍光|けいこう}ペン: highlighter pen
- {蛍光|けいこう}{色|いろ}: fluorescent color
- {蛍光|けいこう}{塗料|とりょう}: fluorescent paint
- {蛍光|けいこう}{物質|ぶっしつ}: fluorescent substance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発光|はっこう}: luminescence — the general phenomenon of emitting light
- LED: LED — increasingly replacing {蛍光|けいこう}{灯|とう} in Japanese households

USAGE:
While traditional {蛍光|けいこう}{灯|とう} (fluorescent tubes) are being phased out in favor of LED lighting in Japan, the word {蛍光|けいこう} remains widely used, especially in {蛍光|けいこう}ペン (highlighter) and {蛍光|けいこう}{色|いろ} (neon/fluorescent colors).
